abstract: BACKGROUND: Intracranial metastases from testicular choriocarcinoma are rare but clinically important due to their proclivity for symptomatic hemorrhage. Emergent surgical resection is often required for the prevention of neurological deterioration. CASE DESCRIPTION: A 22-year-old male with a history of multiple recurrent metastatic intracranial testicular choriocarcinoma presented with an acute right frontal intraparenchymal hemorrhage. He had previously undergone neurosurgical intervention for resection of multiple metastases. An emergent right frontal craniotomy for tumor resection and hematoma evacuation was performed with a novel suction-camera device. Pathology confirmed metastatic choriocarcinoma consistent with the patient's medical history. Postoperatively, the patient resumed chemotherapy and received adjuvant radiation therapy to the resection cavity. Despite these interventions, the patient continued to experience rapid disease progression. CONCLUSION: This case highlights the management of a hemorrhagic brain metastasis from testicular choriocarcinoma. We describe the use of a minimally invasive camera-suction system to augment the process of tumor resection.
abstract_ja: 背景：精巣絨毛癌の頭蓋内転移は稀であるが、症候性出血を起こしやすいため臨床的に重要である。神経学的悪化を防ぐため、緊急の外科的切除が必要となることが多い。症例記述：再発性の転移性頭蓋内精巣絨毛癌の既往を有する22歳男性が、右前頭葉の脳内出血で来院した。以前に複数の転移巣の切除を受けていた。新規の吸引・カメラ装置を用いて、緊急右前頭開頭による腫瘍切除と血腫除去を施行した。病理検査で、既往歴と一致する転移性絨毛癌と確認された。術後は化学療法を再開し、切除腔に対する補助放射線療法を受けた。これらの治療にもかかわらず、患者は急速な病勢進行を続けた。結論：本症例は、精巣絨毛癌による出血性脳転移の治療を示す。腫瘍切除の過程を補助する低侵襲のカメラ吸引システムの使用について述べる。
